[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($83,389.57) vs SMA5($85,195.52)/SMA20($84,186.06)/SMA50($80,282.34): trading near the middle band, below short-term averages
· Strong above SMA100($72,020.59)/SMA200($71,729.55): indicating medium to long-term trend strength
· 52-week position (38.6%): significantly above historical lows, substantial pullback from highs
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 62.9 → 53.3 (staying in neutral range): cooling from overbought territory into neutral, lacking directional conviction
· MACD Histogram -140.8440 → -270.4621 (weakness continues): bearish crossover followed by expanding weakness, suggesting potential for further decline
· Bollinger Bands Current Price Position (Middle Band $84,186.06): band width at 7.60%, indicating moderate volatility, consolidating around the middle band
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($82,570.72): above Pivot S1($77,290.68) and the 200-day Moving Average($71,729.55)
· Swing Resistance ($86,429.35): below Pivot R1($88,426.11) and the 5-day high($86,971.78)
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: 5-day high < 20-day high, 5-day low > 20-day low → confirming entry into a sideways range
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.50x): increased compared to the 5-day average, adding conviction to price movement but lacking direction
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): potential for further downside due to short-term average breaches and persistent MACD weakness; need to monitor for buying interest given the position above long-term averages and historical lows. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
